name: Primal Grid Marching Cubes
definition: A traversal method that operates on a primal grid where cubes are formed by adjacent sample points. It caches distance field values in layers to optimize sampling.
summary: Primal Grid Marching Cubes is a GPU-accelerated isosurface extraction technique that uses compute shaders and a fixed-size output buffer with atomic counters, differing from other GPU variants by avoiding hierarchical reduction.
